question_cn: 「占领中心」和「控制中心」有什么区别？
question_en: What is the difference between occupying the center and controlling it?

options.text_cn: 两者完全相同，没有区别
options.text_en: They mean exactly the same thing.

options.text_cn: 占领中心指把兵走进中心格；控制中心指用棋子或兵的威胁来影响中心，不必实际踏入
options.text_en: Occupying the center means placing a pawn on a central square; controlling it means influencing those squares with pieces or pawn threats without occupying them.

options.text_cn: 占领中心指用后控制中心；控制中心指用兵控制中心
options.text_en: Occupying the center means controlling it with the queen; controlling it means using pawns.

options.text_cn: 占领中心适合初学者；控制中心只有高手才能做到
options.text_en: Occupying the center is for beginners; only experts can control it.

explanation_cn: 占领中心是指把兵直接走到 e4/d4 等格子。控制中心更广泛，包括用远距离的主教、后或兵的侧翼压制来影响中心格，不一定要兵站在那里。现代开局理论更强调动态控制中心。
explanation_en: Occupying the center means moving a pawn directly to squares such as e4 or d4. Controlling it is broader: bishops, the queen, or flank pawns can influence central squares from a distance without a pawn standing there. Modern opening theory emphasizes dynamic central control.
